put.description: Updates an existing assistant. `PUT` replaces the whole assistant. Send every field you want to keep. Omitted optional fields fall back to their defaults: `recordCalls` turns back on, custom summary prompts are cleared. Hooks and extensions that are missing from `callEventHooks` and `extensions` are removed. To change one field, read the assistant with `GET`, change the field, and send the full object back.

put.description: Updates an existing agent. `PUT` replaces the whole agent. Send every field you want to keep. Omitted optional fields fall back to their defaults: `recordCalls` turns back on, custom summary prompts are cleared, the greeting is turned off, and the greeting delay resets to 1000 ms. Hooks and extensions that are missing from `callEventHooks` and `extensions` are removed. To change one field, read the agent with `GET`, change the field, and send the full object back.

get.description:
Opens a server-sent event stream with session lifecycle events for the organization. Each event's `data` is a JSON object. The server sends a heartbeat comment every 30 seconds.

| Event | Data fields |
|---|---|
| `session.created` | `id`, `type`, `state`, `startedAt`, `callingNumber`, `targetNumber` |
| `session.state_changed` | `id`, `type`, `state`, `endedAt`, `durationMs` |
| `session.rejected` | `type`, `reason` (`CONCURRENCY_LIMIT`), `limit` |

allowedMinutes.description: Length of the call window in minutes. The window may cross midnight. Set it together with `allowedMinutesBegin`. `null` means no restriction.

allowedHoursBegin.description: Deprecated. Use `allowedMinutesBegin`. Start of the call window as hour of the day. Ignored when `allowedMinutesBegin` is set.

allowedHours.description: Deprecated. Use `allowedMinutes`. Length of the call window in hours. Ignored when `allowedMinutes` is set.

AssistantUpdate.description: Full replacement of an Assistant's configuration.

systemPrompt.description: Updated main system prompt defining the assistant's role and behavior.
systemPrompt.example: You are an expert support assistant for ACME Gadgets Pro series. Prioritize Pro customer issues.

systemPromptGreeting.description: Updated initial greeting message from the assistant.
systemPromptGreeting.example: Welcome back! How can I assist you today?

telephoneNumberId.description: Updated ID of the telephone number assigned to this assistant (UUID).

llmAudioContentGenerationStrategyId.description: Updated ID of the LLM Audio Content Generation Strategy used by the assistant (UUID).

extensions.description: Updated list of LLM extensions for this assistant. Include existing extension IDs (UUID) to update them, omit ID or provide null to create new ones.

callEventHooks.description: Updated list of Call Event Hooks for this assistant. Include existing hook IDs (UUID) to update them, omit ID or provide null to create new ones.

summaryShortPrompt.description: Custom prompt for the short call summary. `null` uses the default prompt.

summaryLongPrompt.description: Custom prompt for the long call summary. `null` uses the default prompt.

recordCalls.description: Whether calls are recorded. Defaults to `true` when omitted, also on `PUT`.

AssistantUpdateCallEventHook.description: Configuration for a Call Event Hook during an update operation. ID (UUID) is optional (null/missing to create, present to update).

id.description: Unique identifier (UUID) of the call event hook instance to update. If null or missing, a new hook is created.

parameters.description: Hook parameters. `url` is required. A new hook without `method` uses `POST`. An update of an existing hook without `method` keeps its current method. `headers` is always replaced.

method.description: HTTP method of the webhook request. Defaults to `POST` for a new hook. Omitting it on an existing hook keeps the current method.

headers.description: Extra HTTP headers sent with every delivery, for example an authorization header.

AssistantUpdateLlmExtension.description: Configuration for an LLM Extension during an update operation. ID (UUID) is optional (null/missing to create, present to update).

id.description: Unique identifier (UUID) of the LLM extension instance to update. If null or missing, a new extension is created.

type.description: Type identifier for the LLM extension. Required for both create and update.

parameters.description: Specific parameters for this extension instance. Required for both create and update.

AgentUpdate.description: Full replacement of an Agent's configuration.

userValueTypes.description: Updated map defining user-specific value types the agent can handle.

systemPromptTemplate.description: Updated template for the system prompt used by the agent's underlying LLM.
systemPromptTemplate.example: You are an expert sales assistant for ACME Corp focusing on upselling existing customers.

telephoneNumberId.description: Updated ID of the telephone number assigned to this agent (UUID).

llmAudioContentGenerationStrategyId.description: Updated ID of the LLM Audio Content Generation Strategy used by the agent (UUID).

extensions.description: Updated list of LLM extensions for this agent. Include existing extension IDs (UUID) to update them, omit ID or provide null to create new ones.

callEventHooks.description: Updated list of Call Event Hooks for this agent. Include existing hook IDs (UUID) to update them, omit ID or provide null to create new ones.

summaryShortPrompt.description: Custom prompt for the short call summary. `null` uses the default prompt.

summaryLongPrompt.description: Custom prompt for the long call summary. `null` uses the default prompt.

recordCalls.description: Whether calls are recorded. Defaults to `true` when omitted, also on `PUT`.

greetingMessageTemplate.description: Text spoken once shortly after the callee answers, with the same {{placeholders}} as the system prompt. Null or blank disables the greeting.

greetingDelayMs.description: Milliseconds between the callee answering and the greeting.

greetingDiscardOnUserActivity.description: Whether the greeting is dropped when the callee speaks before the delay elapses. When false, the greeting plays at the delay regardless, and anything the callee says before it has finished is not heard by the bot.

AgentUpdateCallEventHook.description: Configuration for a Call Event Hook during an update operation. ID (UUID) is optional (null/missing to create, present to update).

id.description: Unique identifier (UUID) of the call event hook instance to update. If null or missing, a new hook is created.

parameters.description: Hook parameters. `url` is required. A new hook without `method` uses `POST`. An update of an existing hook without `method` keeps its current method. `headers` is always replaced.

method.description: HTTP method of the webhook request. Defaults to `POST` for a new hook. Omitting it on an existing hook keeps the current method.

headers.description: Extra HTTP headers sent with every delivery, for example an authorization header.

AgentUpdateLlmExtension.description: Configuration for an LLM Extension during an update operation. ID (UUID) is optional (null/missing to create, present to update).

id.description: Unique identifier (UUID) of the LLM extension instance to update. If null or missing, a new extension is created.

type.description: Type identifier for the LLM extension. Required for both create and update.

parameters.description: Specific parameters for this extension instance. Required for both create and update.

LlmGenerationStrategyCreateV2.description: Request body for creating a new LLM Generation Strategy.

parameters.description: Type-specific configuration parameters for the strategy. Structure depends on the strategy type. For `phonebot-v2.1`, `voice.voiceId` is the `id` of a voice from [List voices](/api-reference/voices/list).

realtimeVoiceId.description: ID to use when configuring realtime TTS for this voice. Which mode and credentials apply depends on the voice type: for internal/Deepslate voices, this is the platform ID, used with Hosted mode; for external/ElevenLabs voices, this is the provider's voice ID, used with ElevenLabs mode and the caller's own ElevenLabs API key (the key's account must have access to that voice).

public.description: Whether the voice is publicly available to all organizations.

organizationId.description: ID of the organization that owns this voice, or null for public voices.

provider.description: Provider of the underlying voice model, if applicable.

createdAt.description: Timestamp at which the voice was created.

previewUrl.description: URL to fetch a preview of the voice, or null if no preview is available.

draft.description: Whether the voice is still in draft state.

previewState.description: State of the voice's cached preview.

externalVoiceId.description: ID of the voice on the external provider, if applicable.

modelId.description: ID of the external provider's model used to synthesize the voice.

speed.description: Playback speed setting for the external provider.

stability.description: Stability setting for the external provider.

similarityBoost.description: Similarity boost setting for the external provider.

style.description: Style setting for the external provider.

useSpeakerBoost.description: Whether the external provider's speaker boost setting is enabled.

refText.description: Reference text used for cloning this voice, if applicable.

selectionStartMs.description: Start offset in milliseconds of the selected clip used for cloning.

selectionEndMs.description: End offset in milliseconds of the selected clip used for cloning.

refTextOrigin.description: Origin of the reference text used for cloning this voice.

lowLatency.description: Whether low-latency mode is enabled for this voice.
